evals.notes: Regression eval for the every-mention linking rule (this PR). One run each, author-graded: the changed skill meets 5 of 5 expectations; the baseline (first-mention rule, PR #8910 tip) meets 4 of 5 and fails only the expectation that flags the second, bare `with_serial` in a paragraph whose first mention is linked, saying outright that it stays plain. The other four expectations (links in the list and table, no self-link, controls) pass under both versions, so the discriminating signal is that one expectation.
